In how many days is the number of bats made by C more than the average number of bats made by A per day?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average number of bats made by A per day = (90 + 70 + 110 + 85 + 75 + 60)/6 ≈ 81.67

Only on Monday and Tuesday, the number of bats made by C is more than the average number of bats made by A per day.

**∴ T**he number of bats made by C is more than the average number of bats made by A per day on 2 days.
